About

I currently lead data science for brand growth, onboarding, acquisition, and success at Faire. My work covers end-to-end model building: lead scoring, recommendations, entity resolution with LLMs, and the Airflow DAGs that keep those systems running in production.

Before Faire I led pricing and experimentation work at GoPuff and Flexport, and I was a research scientist at the Bank of Canada. Across those roles I have shipped models that move millions of dollars a year, designed experiments that leadership can trust, and translated econometrics into tools that product and finance teams actually use.
